args.title: Bellwether warehouse automation 2026 — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Bellwether article "Warehouse automation in 2026" and its companion piece:

- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources:
- https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse
- https://insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion
